verdicts.reason: Both scatter the left side into pieces: logo, gifts and title sit in a cramped column, the headline is cut off from its subline, and 'Only this Christmas' is pushed into a separate block. The stars are oversized, the URL is tiny, and the photo crop cuts off the model's face. In A, the subline and 'Only this Christmas' are crowded together and the text runs almost into the photo edge. B leaves a bit more gap, but its right-aligned subline sits awkwardly under the headline, so it is only marginally better.
